evidence: Reviewed only quality #6. Frozen path prefix F = .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r2/. Workbook Quality Checks!C7:D7 requires one reasonable reading and reachable capabilities; the older Internal Quality Checks!D7 no-network language is superseded by the public-network delivery profile in the frozen skill and task.toml:23-28. No material ambiguity or unreachable requirement was found. Public scope is finite and explicit: F/task/environment/instructions/security.md:3-11 separates app assets from authored-snippet networking and excludes generated execution and arbitrary blocking native operations; behaviour.md:9-15 distinguishes the shared initial/callback deadline, an interactive completed preview, and static restoration of its actual latest successful form/canvas picture. Removing completed handlers merely because five seconds have elapsed would contradict behaviour.md:11, rather than provide a second reasonable reading. Auto-run timing is deliberately approximate; mode comes from filenames, records have independent identities, stale writes retain dirty fields, and inspect/restore/retry/race semantics are stated in behaviour.md:19-40. Environment reachability: F/task/environment/instructions/integration.md:3-15 supplies the entrypoint, port, health path, arbitrary launch directory, NODE_PATH and DB_PATH; the image installs Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and copies both input directories (environment/Dockerfile:1-16). The empty seed is intentional, and no unavailable account, service, asset, starter app, or fixed API layout is required. Frontend tools/layout/API request fields remain choices (integration.md:3-5 and policy.md:5); the fixed server contract matches the frozen template. F/task/solution/app/server.js:68-117,157-168 provides a concrete reachable SQLite transaction/history/restore-attempt design; src/runtime.ts:30-69,134-138,156-207,264-279,362-396 supplies source guards, completion, actual snapshot retention and isolated preview management. These source readings establish feasibility, not application grades. Verified raw evidence: all 60 artifact hashes matched raw-evidence-index.json (index SHA256 7f658543b146c23c9126ef8867a1f9188dfd5bce0e248290e2a503d143e290d0); all 15 installed solution-file hashes also match the frozen solution. See per-row-review/evidence/06/artifact-hash-verification.json and frozen-installation-binding.json. In qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-01-stricter-r2/full-install-binding.json, the recorded server uses Node v22.23.2, image-global SQLite 12.4.1, cwd /tmp, an alternate DB_PATH, no /app/node_modules, and health 200. runtime-results.json facts.S03.later_interactions records working click and key/input after separate approximately 6.1-second idle periods; facts.S36.callback_shared_run_deadline records a working 403 ms nested-timer control, then time-limit status at 5102.7 ms with nested-control-done restored. canvas-regression.json records identical pixel [224,36,36,255], typed value actual-user-value-741 and Painted red caption before/after error, Stop and timeout; its inspected driver actually paints/types before triggering each ending. history-results.json records original/late retry returning revision 4 after revision 5 exists, and one winner/conflict in each paired race; post-results.json records history and original-result retry after the recorded restart. These are scripted feasibility observations only, not configured judge, Oracle, model, portal, or private-checker results. Other rows retain their separate required-measurement obligations.
counterexample: Adversarial source review, not a new model run: a literal-string renderer could resemble a playground but cannot satisfy ordinary authored JavaScript; the hash-verified computed-mock-gate.json records expected calculation-1790866448472:64 versus an unchanged prior preview and empty console (passesGate=false). A renderer that reruns original source on rollback would lose the user-typed value/canvas drawing and is explicitly excluded by behaviour.md:13. Conforming alternatives considered: a static retained rollback picture, framework-independent frontend, different API fields/layout, and automatic same-attempt restore retry. The public notes allow those choices, and app_context.md plus S37 step 5a explicitly accept static rollback and automatic retry; no alternative was shown to fail because of an ambiguity in the public instructions. This is not a complete audit of every grading row.
